cases.canonicalQuestion: What happens under DISCOVER when both “If the user passes a Normal WIP Roll” and “A Trooper that fails a WIP Roll to Discover a Marker cannot attempt to…” apply?
cases.draftAnswer: Apply both explicit rules. If the user passes a Normal WIP Roll, applying the same MODs as in a BS Attack (Cover, Range, Mimetism…), the target Marker is removed, and must be replaced with the actual Trooper Model, or Weapon or Equipment Token. cases.canonicalQuestion: Can Sixth Sense remove the Poor Visibility penalty created when an MSV user is attacked through White Noise?
